designationHistory.name: Farallon Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt established the Farallon Reservation by Executive Order 1043; it is now Farallon Islands National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Farallon Islands National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

designationHistory.indexOriginal: In 1909, President Theodore Roosevelt established Middle Farallon, the North Farallons, and Noonday Rock as the 24th refuge in the country through Executive Order 1043.
